purpose: First complete Nature-framework adaptation for Chinese event-conditioned hourly flow forecasting
history_rationale: Preserves at least one complete window in all 150 source events; selected from availability, not prediction performance
quantile_authority: User selected Q95 generation and Q99 supplementary evaluation on 2026-09-30
quantile_definition: Per-target empirical linear quantile fitted only to numeric-valid training-event Q rows; event-conditioned high flow, not annual flood frequency
generation_window_label: 1 if any of the following 12 observed hourly Q values is strictly greater than target training Q95
future_observed_precipitation: Offline joint-generation target only; never a forecasting input
temperature: excluded because Chinese unit is unverified
time_handling: Use within-station relative hourly intervals; unknown timezone is retained; no external timestamp joins
split_use: Adopted for v1 preparation as separate target-basin folds; do not pool their train/test labels into a shared model
split_method: Chronological approximately 70/15/15 of target event overlap groups; known conflicts and overlap groups cannot cross split
missing_and_conflicts: No interpolation; reject windows containing invalid P/Q or any time gap; preserve all source rows
normalization: Per-target P and Q mean/population std fitted only to numeric-valid training rows; constant scale replaced by 1 and reported
international_source_time: Before target training cutoff; actual eligible German windows need separate QC. Targets without earlier source observations retain Chinese-only analysis and international effect is NOT_EVALUABLE
model_scope: Preserve shared/real/synthetic encoders, reconstruction and forecast losses; no new architecture modules in v1
